subject: Mathematics
question: What is the place value of 7 in 472?
step_by_step_explanation: In the three-digit number 472: 4 is in Hundreds place (400), 7 is in Tens place (70), and 2 is in Ones place (2). Therefore, the place value is 7 * 10 = 70.
misconception_warning: Students often confuse place value with face value (7).
pedagogical_hint: Ask: How many tens are there in 72?
bilingual_explanation_hindi: 472 संख्या में 7 दहाई के स्थान (Tens place) पर है, इसलिए इसका स्थानीय मान 70 होगा।

subject: Mathematics
question: If an apple is cut into 4 equal slices and Rohan eats 1 slice, what fraction of the apple did he eat?
step_by_step_explanation: A whole apple divided into 4 equal parts has 4 denominator units. Rohan ate 1 part, so the fraction is 1 out of 4, written as 1/4.
misconception_warning: Believing 1/4 is bigger than 1/2 because 4 is greater than 2.
pedagogical_hint: Draw a circle and shade 1 of the 4 equal quadrants.
bilingual_explanation_hindi: एक पूरे सेब को 4 बराबर भागों में बाँटा गया। रोहन ने 1 हिस्सा खाया, तो उसने 1/4 हिस्सा खाया।

question: Which part of the plant absorbs water and minerals from the soil?

step_by_step_explanation: Roots grow underground and anchor the plant while absorbing water and vital dissolved minerals from the soil.
misconception_warning: Thinking stems absorb water because they transport it.
pedagogical_hint: Think about what is buried in the damp earth.
bilingual_explanation_hindi: जड़ें (Roots) मिट्टी से पानी और पोषक तत्वों को सोखती हैं और पौधे को मजबूती देती हैं।

subject: Science / EVS
question: Which of the following is a living thing?
step_by_step_explanation: Living things grow, breathe, reproduce, and require food. While cars move and rivers flow, only the puppy shows biological life processes.
misconception_warning: Assuming anything that moves is alive.
pedagogical_hint: Does it need food and grow on its own?
bilingual_explanation_hindi: कुत्ते का बच्चा (Puppy) एक सजीव प्राणी है क्योंकि यह भोजन करता है, बढ़ता है और सांस लेता है।

subject: English
question: In the sentence 'The swift cheetah ran across the savannah', which word is the verb?
step_by_step_explanation: 'Ran' is an action word representing the movement of the subject (cheetah), which makes it the verb.
misconception_warning: Confusing the adjective 'swift' with the action verb.
pedagogical_hint: Look for the action that is being performed.
bilingual_explanation_hindi: इस वाक्य में 'ran' (दौड़ा) क्रिया (Verb) है क्योंकि यह कार्य को दर्शाता है।

subject: Hindi
question: निम्न में से कौन सा शब्द 'व्यक्तिवाचक संज्ञा' (Proper Noun) है?

subject: Mathematics
question: What is the place value of 7 in 472?
step_by_step_explanation: In the three-digit number 472: 4 is in Hundreds place (400), 7 is in Tens place (70), and 2 is in Ones place (2). Therefore, the place value is 7 * 10 = 70.
misconception_warning: Students often confuse place value with face value (7).
pedagogical_hint: Ask: How many tens are there in 72?
bilingual_explanation_hindi: 472 संख्या में 7 दहाई के स्थान (Tens place) पर है, इसलिए इसका स्थानीय मान 70 होगा।

subject: Mathematics
question: If an apple is cut into 4 equal slices and Rohan eats 1 slice, what fraction of the apple did he eat?
step_by_step_explanation: A whole apple divided into 4 equal parts has 4 denominator units. Rohan ate 1 part, so the fraction is 1 out of 4, written as 1/4.
misconception_warning: Believing 1/4 is bigger than 1/2 because 4 is greater than 2.
pedagogical_hint: Draw a circle and shade 1 of the 4 equal quadrants.

step_by_step_explanation: 'हिमालय' एक विशेष पर्वत का नाम है, इसलिए यह व्यक्तिवाचक संज्ञा है। पहाड़, नदी और शहर जातिवाचक संज्ञा हैं।
misconception_warning: सामान्य नाम और विशेष नाम के अंतर में भ्रम।
pedagogical_hint: क्या यह किसी एक विशिष्ट पर्वत का नाम है?
bilingual_explanation_hindi: Himalaya is a Proper Noun because it refers to a specific mountain range.

subject: Mathematics
question: What is the place value of 7 in 472?
step_by_step_explanation: In the three-digit number 472: 4 is in Hundreds place (400), 7 is in Tens place (70), and 2 is in Ones place (2). Therefore, the place value is 7 * 10 = 70.
misconception_warning: Students often confuse place value with face value (7).
pedagogical_hint: Ask: How many tens are there in 72?
bilingual_explanation_hindi: 472 संख्या में 7 दहाई के स्थान (Tens place) पर है, इसलिए इसका स्थानीय मान 70 होगा।

subject: Mathematics
question: If an apple is cut into 4 equal slices and Rohan eats 1 slice, what fraction of the apple did he eat?
step_by_step_explanation: A whole apple divided into 4 equal parts has 4 denominator units. Rohan ate 1 part, so the fraction is 1 out of 4, written as 1/4.
misconception_warning: Believing 1/4 is bigger than 1/2 because 4 is greater than 2.
pedagogical_hint: Draw a circle and shade 1 of the 4 equal quadrants.
bilingual_explanation_hindi: एक पूरे सेब को 4 बराबर भागों में बाँटा गया। रोहन ने 1 हिस्सा खाया, तो उसने 1/4 हिस्सा खाया।

subject: Science / EVS
question: Which part of the plant absorbs water and minerals from the soil?
step_by_step_explanation: Roots grow underground and anchor the plant while absorbing water and vital dissolved minerals from the soil.
misconception_warning: Thinking stems absorb water because they transport it.
pedagogical_hint: Think about what is buried in the damp earth.
bilingual_explanation_hindi: जड़ें (Roots) मिट्टी से पानी और पोषक तत्वों को सोखती हैं और पौधे को मजबूती देती हैं।

subject: Science / EVS
question: Which of the following is a living thing?
step_by_step_explanation: Living things grow, breathe, reproduce, and require food. While cars move and rivers flow, only the puppy shows biological life processes.
misconception_warning: Assuming anything that moves is alive.
pedagogical_hint: Does it need food and grow on its own?
bilingual_explanation_hindi: कुत्ते का बच्चा (Puppy) एक सजीव प्राणी है क्योंकि यह भोजन करता है, बढ़ता है और सांस लेता है।

subject: English
question: In the sentence 'The swift cheetah ran across the savannah', which word is the verb?
step_by_step_explanation: 'Ran' is an action word representing the movement of the subject (cheetah), which makes it the verb.
misconception_warning: Confusing the adjective 'swift' with the action verb.
pedagogical_hint: Look for the action that is being performed.
bilingual_explanation_hindi: इस वाक्य में 'ran' (दौड़ा) क्रिया (Verb) है क्योंकि यह कार्य को दर्शाता है।
